Disabled Logging Misconfiguration Scenario — iptables State Snapshot
Only a DROP rule is present below -- there is no LOG rule in either snapshot. That absence is the misconfiguration this scenario demonstrates: real traffic is blocked (see disabled_logging_misconfig_evidence.log for the counter deltas) with no rule anywhere to record it.
